videos.publisher: 交通部高速公路局 / Freeway Bureau
watchFor: 分辨進氣豎井、排氣豎井、軸流風機與噴流風機。
跟隨氣流示意，畫出空氣由洞外到車道再排出的路徑。
觀察交控中心的監控工作，區分感測、判斷與致動設備。
watchForEn: Distinguish intake shafts, exhaust shafts, axial fans and jet fans.
Follow the airflow illustration from outside air to roadway and exhaust.
Separate sensing, decision-making and actuation in the control-centre workflow.
videos.verificationBasis: Web search returned this exact video ID, title, publication date and uploader 交通部高速公路局. The publisher description identifies the filmed shafts, fans and control centre; full playback was not tested.
videos.rights: 僅連結或使用出版者提供的嵌入播放器；本課程不複製或自行託管影片。
videos.rightsEn: Link or publisher-provided embed only; no video is copied or hosted by this course.
videos.scope: 官方工程原理或案例導讀；不代表完整建造作業書。觀看重點為本課程原創提問，未宣稱逐格審閱影片。
videos.scopeEn: Official engineering principles or case orientation, not a complete construction procedure. Watch-for points are original course prompts, not a claim of frame-by-frame review.
videos.before: 先列出你已認識的三個構件或系統，並寫下一個需要影片協助回答的問題。
videos.beforeEn: List three components or systems you recognise and write one question to investigate while watching.
videos.after: 自繪一張系統示意圖，標示三個觀看重點及仍待查證的部分；記錄你實際觀看的影片段落。
videos.afterEn: Draw an original system sketch, annotate the three watch-for points and unresolved details, and record the portions you actually watched.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：硬岩為何仍會困住鑽掘機？
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Why can hard rock still trap a TBM?
guides.concept: 岩塊很硬，不代表整體岩盤穩定。裂隙方向、破碎帶、地下水壓與開挖擾動會共同改變掌子面及機身周圍條件。雪山隧道的公開案例適合練習把「材料強度」和「岩體行為」分開判讀。
guides.conceptEn: Hard intact rock does not guarantee a stable rock mass. Discontinuities, fractured zones, groundwater and excavation disturbance influence the face and the ground around the machine. Use the Hsuehshan case to separate material strength from rock-mass behaviour.
procedure: 由官方歷史文獻整理兩欄：已知地層與施工中實際遭遇；把觀察到的湧水、破碎與夾埋分開記錄。
自繪沿線地質示意，標示已查到的破碎帶與地下水可能路徑；未取得精確位置時不自行補數。
建立「現象—可能機制—需要資料」表，例如湧水增加需比對壓力、流量與出水位置，推進阻力改變需比對機況與地層。
對同一假想異常提出至少兩個假說，指定超前調查或現場監測應補足的資訊，再寫出何時應暫停推進並交由工程團隊審查。
procedureEn: Separate the official historical record into anticipated geology and encountered conditions. Record inflow, fragmentation and machine entrapment independently.
Draw an original geological section showing documented fractured zones and plausible water paths. Do not fabricate exact locations.
Create an observation–mechanism–evidence table: an inflow change requires pressure, flow and location information; changed resistance requires both machine and ground evidence.
For one hypothetical anomaly, give two hypotheses and the investigation or monitoring needed to distinguish them. Define the information gap that warrants a stop and engineering review.
evidence: 岩塊性質與岩體結構分列的概念圖。
含至少兩種可能原因的異常判讀表。
說明採用機械鑽掘或其他工法不能僅由岩石硬度決定。
evidenceEn: A concept map separating intact-rock properties from rock-mass structure.
An anomaly table with at least two plausible causes.
An explanation of why hardness alone cannot choose the excavation method.
pitfalls: 把岩塊抗壓強度直接當成掌子面穩定保證。
把有水與有高水壓視為同一觀測。
把歷史個案的處置搬成任何隧道通用配方。
pitfallsEn: Using intact-rock strength as proof of face stability.
Confusing the presence of water with evidence of high water pressure.
Turning one historical response into a universal tunnelling recipe.
guides.sourceNote: 依官方來源的工程原理原創編寫之學習活動；示例與驗收證據是學習要求，並非業主施工計畫、現場試驗資料或本網站已提供的量測資料。
guides.sourceNoteEn: Original learning activities based on principles in official sources. Examples and evidence are learning requirements, not an owner-approved method statement, field test data, or measurement datasets supplied by this website.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：把通風系統畫成可驗證的控制迴路
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Draw ventilation as a verifiable control loop
guides.concept: 風機是致動器，空氣品質與風向風速是回饋，交控與供電則限制可採取的動作。平時稀釋污染物和火災時控制煙流的目標不同，不能把「全部開到最大」當作共同答案。
guides.conceptEn: Fans are actuators; air quality and airflow measurements provide feedback. Traffic control and power availability constrain the response. Routine pollutant dilution and fire-smoke management are different control objectives.
procedure: 觀看官方長版影片，畫出洞外、進氣豎井、車道、排氣豎井四部分，另標出軸流與噴流風機。
在圖旁補上空氣品質、能見度、風向風速及設備狀態等輸入；以箭頭連到控制判斷與致動設備。
建立正常交通、壅塞、火警、停電四列情境表；每列說明控制目標與需要確認的資料，實際設定留給核定文件。
用紙上故障案例測試：若回傳資料中斷或風機有命令卻無狀態確認，哪些量測能判斷是感測、通訊、供電或設備問題？
procedureEn: Watch the official long film and draw outside air, intake shaft, roadway and exhaust shaft. Identify axial and jet fans separately.
Add air-quality, visibility, airflow and equipment-state inputs. Connect these to decisions and actuators.
Create scenarios for normal traffic, congestion, fire and power loss. State the objective and required evidence for each; leave actual settings to approved documentation.
Run a paper fault case: if telemetry disappears or a commanded fan lacks confirmation, what observations distinguish sensing, communication, power and equipment faults?
evidence: 可追蹤輸入、決策、輸出與回饋的控制圖。
四種情境各有不同控制目標的比較表。
一份把命令、回報狀態與實際風流分開驗證的故障追查紀錄。
evidenceEn: A diagram tracing input, decision, output and feedback.
A comparison of control objectives across four operating scenarios.
A fault record checking command, reported state and actual airflow separately.
pitfalls: 把風機運轉回報當成已量到所需風量。
忽略火災位置與煙流分層，套用日常通風邏輯。
將歷史文獻數值當成目前核定的緊急操作設定。
pitfallsEn: Treating a running-status signal as a measurement of adequate airflow.
Applying normal ventilation logic without considering fire location or smoke stratification.
Treating historical document values as current approved emergency settings.

guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 破碎帶水壓、長距離探勘與雙孔道路防災。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Fault-zone water pressure, long-distance investigation and twin-bore road resilience. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 12.9 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。
2006 年事件：雪山隧道開始小型車通行，之後分階段開放大客車。
教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=1e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.0004 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。
教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=304.11 kPa；不是實測或允收值。
教學「有效掘進利用率」：切削速率=1.5 m/h，其餘輸入依單元，結果=11.16 m/day；不是實測或允收值。
教學「出渣運輸節拍」：車輛數=4 個，其餘輸入依單元，結果=137.143 t/h；不是實測或允收值。
factsEn: The public scale is about 12.9 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2006 event: Hsuehshan Tunnel opens to small vehicles before a later staged opening to coaches.
Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=1e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.0004 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 304.11 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching effective boring utilisation: active penetration=1.5 m/h, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 11.16 m/day; not measured or accepted project data.
Teaching muck-transport cycle: vehicles=4 count, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 137.143 t/h; not measured or accepted project data.
timeline: 2006　雪山隧道開始小型車通行，之後分階段開放大客車
2009　方法文獻：FHWA出版隧道土建手冊，這不是本工程施工里程碑。
2026　教材檢視：核對公開尺度並撰寫假想算例，這不是工程完工日期。
timelineEn: 2006 — Hsuehshan Tunnel opens to small vehicles before a later staged opening to coaches
2009 — Method reference: FHWA publishes its civil tunnel manual; this is not a project construction milestone.
2026 — Educational review: public scales are checked and hypothetical exercises authored, not a project completion date.
codes: FHWA-NHI-10-034：道路隧道土建技術手冊，供公開原理比較。
PIARC 道路隧道手冊：系統、營運與維護，須核對跨領域適用性。
codesEn: FHWA-NHI-10-034: Technical Manual for Road Tunnel Civil Elements, for public principles.
PIARC Road Tunnels Manual: systems, operations and maintenance; verify cross-domain applicability.
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：雪山隧道工程
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering
guides.concept: 雪山隧道穿越台灣北部山區，連接北宜高速公路，高公局公開資料列長約12.9公里。本進階課由破碎帶水力連通開始，追蹤開挖、支護及排水的交互作用，再把量測基準和設備資料交給營運端；重點是辨識未知條件如何改變結論，而不重複隧道的入門介紹。
guides.conceptEn: The approximately 12.9 km Hsuehshan Tunnel connects the northern Taiwan expressway with Yilan through mountainous terrain. This advanced course follows fault-zone hydraulic connectivity through excavation, support and drainage, then transfers survey baselines and equipment evidence to operations. Its emphasis is how uncertain conditions change engineering conclusions rather than repeating an introductory description of the tunnel.
procedure: 將雪山山區破碎帶視為多條可能連通水路，研究先進孔揭露的新裂隙如何修正主孔前方預測；不能以已排出的水量推定剩餘岩體必然乾燥。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。
以雪山兩孔及探勘坑之間的水頭差建立假想分層模型，分辨局部排水效果與整座山體地下水位下降；永久襯砌還要承受排水失效狀態。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
將雪山覆土與破碎帶交界分開，檢查高應力岩塊旁的低剛度帶是否使洞壁變形集中；覆土相近的兩個斷面不一定採相同材料模型。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。
以雪山長隧道施工的支護封閉時序為題，分析掌子面前進後尚未形成閉合環的暫時狀態；開挖面距離與支護齡期要與最終尺寸同時保留。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
雪山案例用來比較受地質限制的掘進循環：刀具切削時間、檢查修理及出渣等待必須分開，才能判定設備瓶頸或破碎帶風險誰先控制進度。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。
雪山山區工址的長距離運輸使裝載、交會與卸料相互制約，假想多工作面同時出渣時需檢查共同通道容量，不能只按各面最佳日進尺配置車隊。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
雪山長距離貫通的教學情境著重方向傳遞：將洞口地表基準、導坑及主孔控制網分開覆核，找出共用基準偏差無法靠重複量測自行消除的原因。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
以雪山雙孔道路的一孔維修為情境，分析風門、橫通道及車流邊界如何共同改變網路；不能把施工通風模型直接移作營運控煙模型。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
雪山排水教學把斷層入流和機電故障合併：若雨後淨入流提高同時一台泵維修，剩餘容積與警報延遲要放在同一時間線，不把名義備援當保證。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。
雪山營運交接以排水及通風共同介面為核心，要求一項告警能追到設備位置、供電來源和最後校正；改名或設備更換不能切斷原始趨勢。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
procedureEn: Treat the mountain fault zone as several potentially connected pathways and examine how a newly intercepted fracture changes the forecast ahead of the main bore. Water already drained does not prove the remaining ground is dry. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.

Build a hypothetical layered head model between the two bores and exploratory gallery, separating local drainage from regional drawdown. Permanent lining must also be assessed when the drainage path is unavailable. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.

Separate cover effects from the fault transition and examine whether a compliant band beside stressed blocks concentrates wall movement. Two sections with similar cover need not share the same constitutive model. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.

Study the temporary condition before support closes into a ring as the heading advances. Face distance and support age must remain visible alongside final dimensions when interpreting loads and convergence. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.

Use the Hsuehshan context to separate cutting, inspection and spoil queues in a geologically constrained cycle, determining whether machinery or fault-zone uncertainty controls progress before proposing a production change. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.

Long access distances couple loading, passing and unloading. For simultaneous hypothetical headings, test the shared route against combined demand rather than sizing fleets from each face best daily advance. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.

For long-distance breakthrough, independently examine surface control, pilot-gallery transfer and the main-bore network. Identify why repeated measurements cannot remove a bias inherited from a shared starting datum. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.

Use maintenance in one road bore to examine changes in dampers, passages and traffic boundaries. Construction ventilation cannot be transferred directly into an operational smoke-control model with different occupants and sources. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.

Combine fault inflow and equipment state: after rainfall, increased net inflow can coincide with pump maintenance. Place usable volume and alarm delay on one timeline rather than treating nominal redundancy as guaranteed service. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.

Handover focuses on drainage-ventilation interfaces: each alarm must trace to location, supply and last calibration. Renaming or replacement must preserve the ability to interpret historical trends and distinguish renewal from deterioration. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
evidence: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：比較同里程先進孔的出水衰減與主孔後續入流，保留孔口壓力及時間基準，檢查兩者是否同受降雨控制。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：把各孔測壓管高程校至同一基準，分開穩態水位、降雨尖峰與停泵回升；讀值低於洞頂時仍檢查其他含水層。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：在岩塊與破碎帶兩側設多點伸長計，將破壞方位、開挖距離和支護受力同步比較，以辨認彈性回彈或持續塑性變形。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將每次封閉時間標在收斂曲線，檢查速率改變是否發生於同一施工事件，再比較支護荷重是否有對應反應。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：把停機原因碼對齊刀具檢查和地質里程，另以完整班次的時間收支核對日報，避免只選高產時段評估機器。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。
evidenceEn: For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Compare probe-flow decay with later main-bore inflow at matching chainage, preserving collar pressure and timing to test whether both respond to rainfall. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Level piezometers to one datum and separate steady head, rainfall peaks and outage recovery; low readings in one layer do not exclude pressure elsewhere. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare extensometers on both sides with damage orientation, face distance and support force to distinguish elastic rebound from continuing plastic deformation. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Mark each closure time on convergence histories and test whether rate changes coincide with construction events and corresponding support-load changes. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

For Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Align downtime causes with cutter inspection and geological chainage, checking a complete shift time balance rather than selecting high-output intervals. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.
pitfalls: 若抽水後短暫衰減被誤判為水源耗盡，進入另一連通裂隙時水量可能回升；應用壓力回復試驗區分補注。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。
若只按平均岩級分段，局部剝落與擠壓可被混為同一機制，導致支護剛度增加卻無法容納位移。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。
出渣等待若被列為地質停工，會把後勤問題誤判成岩石太硬，導致無效更換刀具或修改推進策略。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。
若把導坑成果當絕對真值，主孔與導坑可以共同偏離正確方向，兩者彼此吻合仍會錯過預定貫通位置。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
若雨後水量超過平日平均而沿用舊緩衝時間，故障處理可能尚未完成水位已達設備區，形成連鎖失效。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。
pitfallsEn: A temporary decline mistaken for exhaustion can be followed by renewed inflow from another fracture; pressure recovery helps distinguish recharge. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.

Averaged ground classes can confuse spalling with squeezing, increasing stiffness without providing the needed displacement capacity. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.

Spoil queues classified as ground delay falsely suggest hard rock and prompt ineffective cutter replacement or advance changes. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.

Treating pilot control as exact can make both networks agree while both deviate from the intended breakthrough point. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

Using an ordinary-day buffer after rainfall can let water reach equipment before recovery is complete, producing cascading failure. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.overview: 從「雪山隧道工程」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.whyEn: Compare Hsuehshan Tunnel Engineering with Channel Tunnel: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.differenceEn: The Channel Tunnel serves rail traffic; Hsuehshan serves road vehicles, producing different fire scenarios, ventilation needs and occupant distributions.

related.transferEn: Mountain tunnels use iterative investigation, excavation feedback, support and drainage decisions, updating geological models with evidence.
related.difference: 哥達是深埋鐵路基線隧道；雪山是公路隧道，不能把開挖機型、支護間距或營運通風直接移植。

courses.summary: 雪山隧道的故事，是地質不確定性、施工方法與長期協作交織的案例。南口文物館保留隧道鑽掘機模型、剖面與施工歷程，讓看不見的地下工作有了可觀察的入口。從導坑開工到通車的時間線，也提醒學徒把貫通、設備整合與營運準備分開理解。
courses.summaryEn: Hsuehshan Tunnel is a case study in geological uncertainty, construction methods and sustained collaboration. The museum near the south portal uses tunnel-boring-machine models, sections and construction records to make underground work observable. Its timeline from pilot-tunnel construction to traffic opening also separates breakthrough from system integration and operational readiness.

history.title: 導坑工程開工
history.text: 高速公路局大事紀記錄1991年7月15日導坑工程開工。先把導坑與後續主隧道區分，能幫助學徒理解不同工作面、地質資訊及施工階段之間的關係。
history.textEn: The Freeway Bureau dates the start of pilot-tunnel construction to 15 July 1991. Distinguishing the pilot tunnel from the later main tunnels helps learners relate work fronts, geological information and construction stages.

history.title: 全線貫通
history.text: 2004年9月16日完成全線貫通。這是地下開挖的重要節點，卻仍不是車流可以立即進入的終點；課程把它作為從土建工作轉向後續系統整備的討論關卡。
history.textEn: Full breakthrough was achieved on 16 September 2004. It was a major excavation milestone, but did not itself mean traffic could immediately enter. The course uses it to discuss the transition from civil construction to subsequent system readiness.

history.title: 通車營運
history.text: 2006年6月16日通車。將此日期與2004年的貫通並列，可練習追問：在一條可安全使用的公路隧道裡，除了空間被挖通，還必須準備哪些設備、程序與驗證證據？
history.textEn: The tunnel opened to traffic on 16 June 2006. Setting this beside the 2004 breakthrough invites a practical question: beyond an excavated passage, which systems, procedures and verification evidence are needed for a usable road tunnel?

history.textEn: Hsuehshan Tunnel opens to small vehicles before a later staged opening to coaches

history.title: 雪山隧道工程
history.text: 教材檢視：核對公開尺度並撰寫假想算例，這不是工程完工日期。
history.textEn: Educational review: public scales are checked and hypothetical exercises authored, not a project completion date.

courses.connection: 相鄰工程可連到捷運隧道、抽水站與地下車站。用原創剖面圖標示交通空間、排水及通風的介面，再比較道路隧道與軌道隧道的使用情境。這種介面分析可延伸至礦山、地下實驗室與大型建築的機電整合。
courses.connectionEn: Related civil works include metro tunnels, pumping stations and underground stations. Use an original section diagram to mark interfaces among traffic space, drainage and ventilation, then compare road and rail operating contexts. This interface analysis also transfers to mines, underground laboratories and building-services integration.
